notes_zh:
- **修复** 剪贴板历史条目较多时（数千至上万条），复制新内容后调出快捷面板明显卡顿、甚至长时间无响应的问题
- **修复** 一次复制多张图片的条目：列表缩略图显示文件数量角标，预览区正确显示文件列表而非只显示第一张图
notes_en:
- **Fix** Noticeable lag (or long hangs) when invoking the quick panel right after copying, on large histories (thousands to tens of thousands of clips)
- **Fix** Multi-image copies now show a file-count badge on the list thumbnail and preview as a file list instead of only the first image

beta.notes_zh: - **修复** 连接多个 AI Agent（MCP）会话后，App 可能整体卡住：状态栏菜单点不开、设置窗口只显示 Dock 图标不出窗口、快捷面板按 ESC 关闭延迟约 1 秒
beta.notes_en: - **Fix** With many concurrent AI Agent (MCP) sessions connected, the app could become unresponsive — status bar menu not opening, the settings window showing only a Dock icon, and quick panel ESC dismissal delayed by about 1 second
